title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: NOTIFICATION message
entities.description: A NAS message that could not be delivered due to handover and is retransmitted by the MME.

entities.name: Intra MME handover
entities.description: A handover procedure within the same MME that may cause non-delivery of NAS PDUs.

entities.name: Successful handover completion
entities.description: Condition where intra MME handover completes successfully, triggering retransmission of the NOTIFICATION message.

entities.name: Handover procedure failure
entities.description: Condition where handover procedure fails but S1 signalling connection exists, triggering retransmission of the NOTIFICATION message.

entities.name: S1 signalling connection exists
entities.description: Condition indicating the S1 signalling connection is still present despite handover failure.

entities.name: MME retransmits NOTIFICATION message
entities.description: Behavior where the MME retransmits the NOTIFICATION message after handover success or failure with S1 connection.

relations.description: Intra MME handover causes non-delivery of the NOTIFICATION message.
Successful handover completion establishes MME retransmission of the NOTIFICATION message.
Handover failure with S1 connection existing establishes MME retransmission of the NOTIFICATION message.
Handover failure condition is guarded by the presence of S1 signalling connection.
MME retransmission action is triggered by the NOTIFICATION message.
